overview: Rainbow AI is a WhatsApp AI assistant for Pelangi Capsule Hostel & Southern Homestay. It handles guest inquiries, booking workflows, and multi-turn conversations via Baileys WebSocket. The focus is on reliability, response quality, and intent classification accuracy.
goals: Improve intent classification accuracy for booking and inquiry intents
Enhance conversation context handling for multi-turn dialogues
Add better fallback responses when AI confidence is low
Improve the booking workflow steps in workflows.json
Prioritize reliability and response quality over new features
Enforce strict business profile separation â€” each profile's data files must only contain content specific to that business, with zero contamination from other profiles
Fix data-makan and data-southern profiles which currently contain copy-pasted Pelangi Capsule Hostel content

epics.title: Intent Classification Accuracy
epics.description: Improve how the system classifies incoming messages into the correct intent categories, especially for booking and inquiry intents.

epics.title: Multi-Turn Conversation Context
epics.description: Enhance the system's ability to track and use conversation context across multiple turns of dialogue.

epics.title: Fallback & Confidence Handling
epics.description: Improve responses when the AI has low confidence or cannot classify an intent reliably.

epics.title: Booking Workflow Improvements
epics.description: Improve the booking workflow steps, transitions, and validation logic in workflows.json and related pipeline code.

epics.title: Test Suite Reliability
epics.description: Fix failing tests and improve test coverage for core intent and conversation logic.

epics.title: Business Profile Separation
epics.description: Ensure strict data isolation between all business profiles. Each profile's data files (knowledge.json, intents.json, intent-keywords.json, routing.json, templates.json, workflows.json) must contain ONLY content specific to that business. No profile may contain identifiers, addresses, credentials, pricing, or intents belonging to a different business.

userStories.title: Intent Classification Error Pattern Grouper CLI
userStories.description: CLI tool to parse production logs and group intent misclassifications by error type (false positives, false negatives, boundary confusions) with keywords and confidence ranges for actionable remediation.
acceptanceCriteria: `npx spiral group-classification-errors --profile data-pelangi --output errors.json` clusters misclassifications by type, showing frequency, confidence ranges, and 3 example messages per cluster
Report identifies problematic keyword pairs (e.g., 'booking' vs 'inquiry') and suggests additions to `src/assistant/data/intent-keywords.json`
Integration test with sample misclassification log produces deterministic clustering with >80% inter-cluster separation

userStories.title: Fallback Response Tone Validator CLI
userStories.description: Validate that fallback response templates in knowledge.json maintain appropriate tone per profile and intent type, flagging dismissive language and tone inconsistencies.
acceptanceCriteria: `npx spiral validate-response-tone --profile data-makan --output tone-report.json` scans knowledge.json and flags dismissive patterns (e.g., 'cannot help', 'not possible')
Report shows tone distribution across intent groups with counts (booking responses should avg sentiment >0.6 apologetic, inquiry responses >0.7 helpful)
Generates suggested alternatives via `--suggest-fixes` flag, stored in `tone-suggestions.json`

userStories.title: Multi-Turn Conversation Context Debugger CLI
userStories.description: Interactive CLI to replay conversations turn-by-turn, visualizing context window state, classifier decisions, and routing path at each step to diagnose multi-turn dialogue failures.
acceptanceCriteria: `npx spiral debug-conversation --message-id <UUID> --profile data-pelangi` replays conversation showing context indices included/excluded, classified intent + confidence, routed action at each turn
Exports trace as JSON with per-turn state snapshot (context size, top-3 intent candidates, routing decision, confidence percentile)
Test validates trace against database `rainbow_messages` and `rainbow_conversations` records for 3-turn sample conversation

userStories.title: Booking Success Funnel Analyzer with Per-Profile Conversion Tracking

userStories.title: Booking Workflow Step Execution Dry-Run Endpoint

userStories.title: Profile Isolation Violations Auto-Repair Tool
userStories.description: Detect and automatically repair data contamination that violates profile isolation rules, preventing cross-profile data leakage
acceptanceCriteria: Create CLI command npm run repair-profile-isolation that detects violations: guests with multi-profile references, intent keywords in wrong profiles, routing.json intent routes to foreign workflows
For each violation, generate suggestion (delete cross-profile data, reassign to correct profile, or flag for manual review); apply fix and log to profile_isolation_repairs table
Output JSON report with: violations_found, repairs_applied, repairs_flagged, before/after data counts per profile, timestamp

userStories.title: Booking Confirmation Pre-flight Checklist with Detailed Violation Report
userStories.description: Add admin endpoint that validates a booking against all business rules before confirmation: guest existence, room availability, date validity, no schedule conflicts, pricing accuracy. Returns detailed violation report with impact levels and suggested corrections to prevent booking errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/routes/admin/booking-preflight.ts with POST /admin/bookings/preflight?booking_id= endpoint returning { passed: bool, violations: [], warnings: [], estimated_revenue: number }

Validation checks: guest exists in database, selected room_type is valid for profile, check_in date is not in past, no overlapping bookings exist, guest age/profile restrictions met, pricing matches current rate card

For each violation, endpoint logs: violation_type (string), description (string), impact_level ('critical'|'warning'), suggested_fix (string); example: { violation_type: 'past_date', description: 'Check-in date 2026-03-20 is in past', impact_level: 'critical', suggested_fix: 'Select check-in date 2026-03-24 or later' }

acceptanceCriteria: Add database constraint in Drizzle schema (shared/schema-tables.ts) that enforces rainbow_messages.profile_id must match conversation's profile_id on insert
Implement profile_id check in src/lib/conversation.ts getConversationMessages() that validates all fetched messages belong to expected profile_id, throws ProfileMismatchError if violation detected
Add unit test in tests/unit/conversation-profile-isolation.test.ts asserting queries for messages with mismatched profile_id are rejected

acceptanceCriteria: classifyIntent() in src/assistant/intents.ts returns {intent, confidence, alternatives} object with confidence score 0-1
chat-engine.ts routes to escalation when confidence < CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD (configurable per-profile in settings.json)
Escalation uses profile-aware templates from src/assistant/data/*/knowledge.json escalation responses
technicalNotes: File to edit: src/assistant/intents.ts (classifyIntent function) - add confidence calculation from intent match score
File to edit: src/assistant/chat-engine.ts (classifyAndRespond function) - add confidence check before action execution
Config: src/assistant/data/settings.json - add CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD field (default 0.7)
Test command: npm run test:run -- tests/assistant/intents.test.ts -t 'confidence'
